description: Named variables of map6_s04 (Amusement Park - Cybil boss, Alessa kidnapping) that its Lua reads and writes with sh.map.get / sh.map.set or passes by name ("name[i]"). Each entry says where the value lives: "symbol" (an array of tables.json or a game variable shared with the engine; with "storage" too, the storage is used where the symbol is missing), "object" (the draw records of world_objects.json, starting at that object) or "storage" (a value only the scripts keep, alive for the whole run); "type" is s8/u8/s16/u16/s32/u32 (default s32) or ref (an address); "count" elements lie "stride" bytes apart from "offset". "layout" gives several names at once: vec3 (.x/.y/.z, s32 Q12 metres), svec3 (s16, Q12 turns for angles), pose (.pos, .rot) and placement (.pos). Variables every map shares are in gamedata/config/map_vars.json; this file is looked up first, and a mod patches it with its own copy. On map6_s04 (the amusement park, Cybil fight and Alessa's kidnapping): the voice line and the voice commands of the exorcism and the "I figured" scene; ending_camera_angle (also the carousel's angle), carousel_drift_speed (the carousel's own turning speed) and carousel_chair_hidden; the park scene sound volume and pan mode; flauros is the pose of the small Flauros drawn while M6S04_SmallFlaurosVisible is set (it follows the SFLAU track), flauros_ray_target the point its ray ends at, flauros_glow_stage its glow stage; smoke_emitter.* the smoke column fields (the parasite's blood) and map_effect_flags.
